description: The spec documents only 400/403/404 for GET /envs and 400/403/404/422 for PATCH /envs/{id}, with no coded error bodies. Live probes against https://api.inngest.com/v2 with a branch-environment signing key on 2026-10-06: PATCH /envs/branch-00000000 (unknown id, X-Inngest-Env: branch) answers 404 {errors:[{code:"env_not_found",message:"Environment not found"}]}, while the real id branch-1637d8ff answers 200. GET /envs and PATCH /envs/branch-1637d8ff with X-Inngest-Env naming an environment that does not exist answer 401 {errors:[{code:"authorization_header_missing",message:"authorization header missing or invalid"}]}, while X-Inngest-Env: branch answers 200. An invalid or missing key returns the same 401 body, so the wire cannot tell an unknown environment name from bad credentials.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: No environment has the given id (Inngest `env_not_found`, HTTP 404).

The key cannot reach the environment named by `X-Inngest-Env` (Inngest `authorization_header_missing`, HTTP 401). Inngest answers this both when no environment has that name for the key and when the key itself is missing or invalid.
